scope: Countywide public USGS waterways reference basemap; default for Rivers and Reservoirs only. No AGOL items, memberships, private records or permissions changed.

sourceAccounting.scope: County-intersecting segments retained inside county envelope, including border-crossing portions. Not a complete verified irrigation-district inventory.
sourceAccounting.dimensionPolicy: XY display geometry; no source Z/M or vertical-datum interpretation.

observed: Cold Rivers load starts on F.R.O.G. Waterways; county overview includes western waterways outside original pilot boxes.
Reservoirs starts on F.R.O.G. Waterways; Weather retains Dark Gray.
Mendota selection opens 3D with named canals/ditches and unnamed channel detail.
Weather then Rivers restores the 3D viewpoint and waterways basemap; cancelled layer loads do not trigger false fallback.
Helm Ditch map selection opens evidence with source Canal classification, mainstem link, unknown mapped direction and missing sequence fields explicitly visible.
Esri duplicate water-area names are excluded for the 496 custom name anchors.

limitations: Reference snapshot, not live water flow, gate operation, hydraulic routing, predicted inundation or a complete ditch inventory.
Mapped primary network pointers do not establish all irrigation-system connections; unknown/blank fields remain unknown.
One anchor per normalized name can omit labels from close-up extents where its anchor is offscreen or collides.
Publisher feature lookups can be slow; a visible progress message and superseded-selection guards preserve context.
3D terrain source is unchanged; this release adds hydrographic reference, not improved elevation.
rollback: Redeploy 7ae5bf00b8387f817eeb76268578e755418569b6 (0.28.0); no data migration. Prior pilot tiles retained for existing open clients.
